page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a high-density storage server type built on the KVM hypervisor. The compute configuration consists of 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. System memory is sized at 96.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The defining physical attribute of this instance is its 70866 GB local HDD storage capacity. High local magnetic disk capacity suits workloads requiring extreme storage density per node, though sequential HDD performance presents latency tradeoffs compared to local NVMe SSD storage. The hardware profile does not include GPU accelerators.

By offering substantial magnetic disk capacity alongside a moderate compute and memory allocation, the ecs.d1.6xlarge provides a cost-effective hardware density profile for large-scale data retention. Primary workload fits include big data processing clusters, MapReduce frameworks, distributed file systems, centralized log ingestion, and batch data warehousing operations.
